candidates.formal_type:
∀ {V : Type u_1} [inst : AddCommGroup.{u_1} V] [inst_1 : Module.{0, u_1} Complex V]
  [FiniteDimensional.{0, u_1} Complex V] (B : LinearMap.BilinForm.{0, u_1} Complex V),
  (∀ (x y : V),
      Eq.{1} (DFunLike.coe.{u_1 + 1, u_1 + 1, 1} (DFunLike.coe.{u_1 + 1, u_1 + 1, u_1 + 1} B x) y)
        (DFunLike.coe.{u_1 + 1, u_1 + 1, 1} (DFunLike.coe.{u_1 + 1, u_1 + 1, u_1 + 1} B y) x)) →
    Not (LinearMap.BilinForm.Nondegenerate.{0, u_1} B) →
      Exists.{2} fun W =>
        Exists.{1} fun x =>
          Exists.{1} fun x_1 =>
            Exists.{1} fun B' =>
              And
                (∀ (x_2 y : W),
                  Eq.{1} (DFunLike.coe.{1, 1, 1} (DFunLike.coe.{1, 1, 1} B' x_2) y)
                    (DFunLike.coe.{1, 1, 1} (DFunLike.coe.{1, 1, 1} B' y) x_2))
                (And (LinearMap.BilinForm.Nondegenerate.{0, 0} B')
                  (Exists.{u_1 + 1} fun φ =>
                    And (Function.Surjective.{u_1 + 1, 1} (DFunLike.coe.{u_1 + 1, u_1 + 1, 1} φ))
                      (Eq.{u_1 + 1} (RingHom.ker.{u_1, 0, u_1} (AlgHom.toRingHom.{0, u_1, 0} φ))
                        (Ring.jacobson.{u_1} (Etingof.Problem3_9_5.CliffAlg.{u_1} B)))))
